# White Rose Research Online

> > A collaborative open-access institutional repository for three UK universities (Leeds, Sheffield, York) built on the EPrints platform, enabling discovery and sharing of research outputs.

White Rose Research Online is a multi-university research repository operated by White Rose Libraries, providing open access to scholarly outputs from the University of Leeds, University of Sheffield, and University of York. The platform uses EPrints software and supports institutional mandates for research metrics and REF compliance.
